title: Only 12% Of Adults Can Pass This Flight Attendant Entrance Exam
summary: Ten questions test cabin safety, emergencies, crew coordination and aircraft knowledge.

landing.intro: The service questions seem easy. Then the exam moves into decompression, evacuation and cabin safety.

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment challenge uses broad cabin-safety principles shared across international aviation. It tests passenger safety, emergency priorities, crew coordination and aircraft systems without relying on one airline’s exact commands or procedures.

Choose one answer for each question. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal, where the complete answer review is available to unlock.

steps: Answer ten increasingly difficult cabin crew questions.
Choose the safest or most accurate response.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an official airline recruitment, safety, medical or employment assessment. Procedures and commands vary by aircraft, airline and jurisdiction.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your cabin crew aptitude score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Cabin Safety Standout
profile-1.copy: You balanced passenger care with calm emergency judgment from start to finish. Even the technical cabin questions stayed clear.

profile-2.title: The Flight Attendant Ace
profile-2.copy: You passed a challenge that catches out most adults. Your instincts stayed sharp from turbulence procedures to the final safety briefing.

profile-3.title: The Calm Crew Member
profile-3.copy: You built a strong result across service, safety and emergency scenarios. A few specialist details kept the pass mark just out of reach.

profile-4.title: The Promising Candidate
profile-4.copy: The essential priorities clicked, while the aircraft systems and emergency details proved tougher. The review explains every missed answer.

profile-5.title: The First-Flight Recruit
profile-5.copy: This exam moved quickly beyond passenger service into safety-critical knowledge. Your strongest category shows where your cabin instincts already stand out.

score.passed: You passed the Flight Attendant entrance challenge!

flightattendant-q1.question: What is a flight attendant’s primary responsibility?

flightattendant-q2.question: When significant turbulence begins, what is the key immediate cabin priority?

answers.a2: Secure yourself and the cabin as procedures require
answers.a4: Ask passengers to stand and stretch

flightattendant-q3.question: If oxygen masks drop during decompression, what should you normally do before helping another person?

flightattendant-q4.question: During an emergency evacuation, what should passengers generally do with cabin baggage?

flightattendant-q5.question: Why should passengers count the rows between their seat and the nearest usable exits?

answers.a1: Smoke or darkness may make exits harder to see

flightattendant-q6.question: In aviation, what is crew resource management mainly designed to strengthen?

flightattendant-q8.question: Which three elements make up the fire triangle?

flightattendant-q9.question: What is the main purpose of floor-level emergency lighting?

answers.a1: To help guide people toward exits when visibility is poor

flightattendant-q10.question: Why must passengers pay attention to the safety briefing even if they fly often?

answers.a1: It reveals the flight’s cruising altitude
answers.a2: Emergency equipment and procedures can differ by aircraft
answers.a3: It determines the order of baggage delivery
answers.a4: It explains how ticket prices were set
